##### Project general facts

Azizi Central is a contemporary residential development by Azizi Developments, located in the heart of Al Furjan. The project is designed to deliver a vibrant urban lifestyle, combining modern architecture with a well-connected location and a focus on comfort and everyday convenience.

The development offers a selection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully planned to ensure seamless layouts and efficient use of space. Residents benefit from a range of amenities, including swimming pools, a fully equipped gym, and barbecue areas, creating an environment that supports both relaxation and an active lifestyle while fostering a sense of community.

Interiors are designed with a modern aesthetic and functional layouts that enhance comfort and practicality. Apartments feature quality finishes and well-organized living spaces, creating a clean and contemporary atmosphere suited for modern urban living.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
